risk_note: RV2 (union adapter, orders, commission, platform metrics; funds). FU-PDD-NET-N, plan A (D10-574). mapPddOrder writes est_commission_fen as promotion_amount minus duo_id_service_fee, null when the fee is missing, never counted as 0 (08 BR-CALC-02, BR-CALC-03: est and settle are net, the fee is deducted only in the adapter). The snapshot, the retry, refresh and bases no longer subtract; N is settle ?? est, so the wallet, order figures, earnings and the other readers of est line up without changes. A new order without the fee stays at version 0 with SERVICE_FEE_RATE_MISSING pending. An order with an estimate keeps it and its version does not move, which removes the wallet failure B2-03q left; the missing fee is counted (couli_pdd_service_fee_missing_total, no amount, no order number) with a warning alert (D10-574 ②). No migration, no contract, no backfill. Frozen tests that pinned est as gross are changed in the author commit (D10-581, D10-327, list couli-runs/B1-08zh/test-change-list.md), not relaxed: they still pin amounts or reasons. Known and unchanged: duo_id_service_fee covers base and reward commission but is taken only from the base, so N is low when there is a level reward (conservative, owner's formula of 2026-10-02), pending CAP-PDD-04; settle is treated as net, and CAP-PDD-07 is a precondition of credit.enabled.pdd. CommissionEstimatesDependencies keeps an unread optional serviceFeeDeducted so the frozen kit compiles (FU-ESTIMATES-FEE-DEP-CLEANUP).
